title: Land Codex error fix, Create adding windows, extras stacking, git_history test patience
body:
Already implemented and committed on branch fix/codex-failure-detail (every commit carries this card's trailer). Do NOT change code unless a rebase conflicts.

1. In your worktree: git merge --ff-only fix/codex-failure-detail (if it is not a fast-forward because main moved: git reset --hard fix/codex-failure-detail, then git rebase main, resolving any conflict).
2. Gate: cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent. git_history timing tests now wait up to TEST_PATIENCE (60 s); a failure elsewhere under load: re-run once before treating it as real.
3. integrate + wait (close-out lines below). On exit 3 read list --json, fix, re-integrate.

Docs: docs/ai-oneshot.md, docs/project-layouts.md (Create Layout, reconciliation rule 4-5), spec amendment at the top of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md.
